pages.text: $(l)MineOS$() is a full graphical OS with windows, a file manager, a paint program and an app store.$(br2)Needs a $(l)tier 3$() graphics card and screen, $(l)2x tier 3.5 RAM$() and an $(item)Internet Card$().
Boot OpenOS and run:$(br2)$(l)pastebin run PDE3eVsL$()$(br2)The installer checks your hardware first and tells you what is missing.
